statements.text: By Gödel’s theorem and related considerations, certain aspects of human consciousness, such as mathematical understanding, lie beyond the scope of any computational system.
statements.scope: the Gödelian argument of The Emperor’s New Mind (1989) and Shadows of the Mind (1994)

sources.quote: both books argued, by appealing to Gödel’s theorem and other considerations, that certain aspects of human consciousness, such as understanding, must be beyond the scope of any computational system
